biggest_catch: The offer ends September 30, 2026 - referrals must qualify by then.
catches: Existing member earns $100 cash when the referred new member qualifies; new member earns $200.
New member must mention the referring member's name at account opening; promo code FRIEND26 and the member's name online, or the referral card in person.
New member qualifications (within first 90 days): open and deposit $20 into a new checking account, make 30 Visa debit card transactions of at least $5 each, and sign up for e-statements.
Limit of five (5) referrals per member ($500).
Existing member's bonus is deposited within 10 business days after the new member qualifies.
Bonus may be considered income and reported on 1099-MISC or 1099-INT.
Not valid on business or fiduciary accounts; membership eligibility applies (8 Ohio counties).
Offer may be amended, suspended, or discontinued at any time; offer ends September 30, 2026.
